envelope.description: Summaries are stored only for current documents

body.title: Summaries are stored only for current documents
body.summary: Adds writeDocSummaryIfCurrent (checks inside the write transaction that the entity exists with the summarised body; returns written, entity-gone or body-changed; throws as writeDocSummary does) and routes summariseDoc's two writes through it, with SummariseDocResult.skipped gaining entity-gone and body-changed and the placeholder precedence the LLD states; writeDocSummary is unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: writeDocSummaryIfCurrent writes for a current entity, returns entity-gone or body-changed otherwise and throws for an unregistered repo.
summariseDoc reports the skip reasons, a thrown summary write as persistence-failed and a thrown placeholder write with the model error.
writeDocSummary and its callers are unchanged.

tests.name: src/db/__tests__/doc-summaries-lmdb.test.ts: writeDocSummaryIfCurrent writes when the entity exists with the summarised body, writes nothing and returns entity-gone or body-changed otherwise, and throws for an unregistered repo; writeDocSummary is unchanged

src/analyze/summariser/__tests__/summarise-doc-current.test.ts: summariseDoc reports a summary the conditional write did not store as skipped entity-gone or body-changed, a thrown summary write as persistence-failed, a thrown placeholder write with the original model error, and a placeholder write that finds the entity gone or changed as skipped with that reason
